# Content kinds

The kinds of content the core and the modules define. An entry is a `.tres` resource of its kind's class, which extends `ContentEntry`, and its game lists it in a content pack (`game/data/content.tres`); `node tools/new_content.js --game <id> --kind <kind> --id <id>` writes one and lists it. Besides the fields below, every entry has its `id` (a `StringName` that never changes once it ships) and `custom_fields` (JSON-safe data a game or mod attaches). A game has the core's kinds and those of the modules it links. Each entry's `find_problems()` checks its fields and the ids they name against the game's content, and a problem fails validation. An enum field is written as its number.

| Kind | Layer | Class | Script |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [achievement](#achievement) | core | `AchievementData` | `tiamat/core/profile/achievement_data.gd` |

## achievement

`AchievementData` (core). Something the player achieved once, kept by the player's profile (`GameProfile`) across every save. Content unlocks one with the action `UNLOCK_ACHIEVEMENT <id>`, usually from a trigger (`TriggerData`), and asks about one with the condition `ACHIEVEMENT_UNLOCKED <id>`. One that counts a profile counter (`progress_flag`, `goal`) needs no trigger: the profile unlocks it once the counter reaches its goal.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `description` | `String`, several lines | `""` |  |
| `icon` | `Texture2D` |  |  |
| `hidden` | `bool` | `false` | Whether menus hide its name and description until it is unlocked. |
| `progress_flag` | `StringName` |  | The profile counter (a `GameProfile` flag that `ADD_PROFILE_FLAG` raises) it counts toward `goal`, or none. The profile unlocks it once the counter reaches the goal, and the achievements menu shows how far the player is. |
| `goal` | `int` | `0` | What `progress_flag` reaches to unlock it. |
| `order` | `int` | `0` | Where it stands among the locked ones in the achievements menu: lower first, then by id, so the list reads as the way through the game. |

## audio_cue

`AudioCueData` (core). A sound or a piece of music the game plays by its id (`GameAudio`). A cue without a stream is a slot waiting for its audio: nothing is heard, though a sound that rumbles is still felt.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cue_type` | `CueType` | `CueType.SFX` | Values: SFX = 0, MUSIC = 1. |
| `stream` | `AudioStream` |  |  |
| `volume_db` | `float`, -60 to 12 | `0.0` |  |
| `pitch_min` | `float`, 0.5 to 2 | `1.0` |  |
| `pitch_max` | `float`, 0.5 to 2 | `1.0` |  |
| `fade_seconds` | `float`, 0 to 10 | `1.0` | Music: how long it takes to fade in, and the music before it to fade out. |
| `max_voices` | `int`, 1 to 8 | `3` | Sounds: how many of the cue play at once at most; one more stops the oldest of them. |
| `hearing_distance` | `float`, 16 to 4000 | `640.0` | Sounds played at a place in the world: how far from the view's centre they are still heard, in pixels. |
| `rumble` | `float`, 0 to 1 | `0.0` | Sounds: how hard the player's gamepad or phone shakes as the sound plays, from 0 (not at all) to 1 (`Haptics`), less the farther away a sound played at a place is; and for how long. |
| `rumble_seconds` | `float`, 0.01 to 1 | `0.1` |  |

## hint

`HintData` (core). A tip the player reads once: how to move, that a sign can be read, what a new menu does. Content shows one with the action `SHOW_HINT <id>`, usually from a trigger (`TriggerData`) on what makes it useful, and asks about one with the condition `HINT_SHOWN <id>`. The player's profile (`GameProfile`) keeps which hints showed, so a hint shows once across every save, and none shows while the player turns hints off (`GameSettings.hints`). The HUD shows them on a status line that shows hints (`StatusLine.shows_hints`), and the pause menu's tips list the ones the player has seen (`TipsMenu`).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String`, several lines | `""` |  |

## location

`WorldLocationData` (core). A place of the world the player can be in: its scene, where travel puts the player in it (its `WorldSpawnPoint` nodes, `WorldTravelService`), the music that plays there, whether the weather reaches it and the region it belongs to. The game starts and wakes the player in locations of its own (`GameDefinition`), and portals (`InteractivePortal`) lead between them.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  | The name the player reads. |
| `scene_path` | `String`, a *.tscn file |  | The scene of the place; validation opens it to check its spawn points, portals and the content its nodes name. |
| `type` | `LocationType` | `LocationType.TOWN` | Values: TOWN = 0, INTERIOR = 1, WILDERNESS = 2, DUNGEON = 3. |
| `weather_exposed` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the weather shows here (`WeatherOverlay`); off for a place indoors. |
| `default_spawn_id` | `StringName` |  | The spawn point (`WorldSpawnPoint.spawn_id`) travel puts the player at when it names none; the scene must have it. |
| `music_cue_id` | `StringName` |  | The music (`AudioCueData`, a `MUSIC` cue) that plays while the player is here; empty, silence. |
| `region_id` | `StringName` |  | The region the location belongs to (`RegionData`); empty for none. |

## minigame

`MiniGameDefinition` (core). A minigame the game can start through `MiniGameHost.run()`: from a station in the world (`MiniGameStation`), which can offer several for the player to pick from, such as a campaign's battles, each open once its `condition` holds.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` | The name the player picks it by at a station that offers several. |
| `description` | `String`, several lines | `""` | A line under the name there. |
| `order` | `int` | `0` | Where it stands among the minigames the pause menu's Challenges list: lower first, then by id (a campaign's battles in the order they are fought). |
| `condition` | `String` | `""` | What must hold for the player to pick it there (`GameRules` syntax; empty: always): `MINIGAME_WON ford_battle` opens a battle once the one before it is won. A locked one says what it needs (`GameRules.describe()`). |
| `score_name` | `String` | `""` | What its score counts, in words the player reads ("Units Left"): the list of a station shows the player's best score under it once they have one. Empty: the score shows nowhere. The best score stays in the player's profile, across saves (`get_best_score()`), so a record can show it (`RecordData.flag`, `best_score_key()`). |
| `score_goals` | `PackedInt32Array` | `PackedInt32Array()` | The scores the player aims for, lowest first, each above the one before (Units Left 2, 3, 4): each one their best score reaches is a star, which the list of a station and the pause menu's Challenges show (★★☆) with the score the next star needs, and which `MINIGAME_STARS` counts. Needs a `score_name`; empty: no stars. |
| `scene` | `PackedScene` |  | Scene whose root extends `MiniGame`. |
| `pause_world` | `bool` | `true` | Pauses the world (clock, actors, other menus) while the minigame runs. |
| `success_actions` | `PackedStringArray` | `PackedStringArray()` | Actions (`GameRules` syntax) run when the player wins or loses. |
| `failure_actions` | `PackedStringArray` | `PackedStringArray()` |  |
| `music_cue_id` | `StringName` | `&""` | The music it plays over the world's while it runs (`GameAudio.push_music()`); empty: the world's plays on. |
| `settings` | `Dictionary` | `{}` | Tuning passed to the minigame's `setup()`; the caller's context overrides it. The minigame checks it (`MiniGame.find_settings_problems()`). |

## record

`RecordData` (core). A number the player's profile keeps across every save, shown under Records in the achievements menu (`AchievementsMenu`): crops harvested, the deepest depth reached. It reads a profile counter (`GameProfile`, `flag`) that content raises with `ADD_PROFILE_FLAG` (a count) or `RAISE_PROFILE_FLAG` (a best), usually from a trigger (`TriggerData`) on what the player does, or that the game's code sets.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `flag` | `StringName` |  | The profile counter it shows. |
| `order` | `int` | `0` | Where it stands among the records: lower first, then by id. |

## region

`RegionData` (core). A part of the world that holds some locations (`WorldLocationData.region_id`), such as a valley or the coast: the player enters it when they travel to one of its locations from outside it (`WorldTravel.region_changed`), and content asks where they are with `REGION`.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  |  |

## trigger

`TriggerData` (core). What content does when something happens: when `event` fires and `condition` holds, `GameTriggers` runs `actions`. Story beats, rewards for what the player does and achievements are triggers instead of code, so a game wires its modules together in data.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | `StringName` |  | The event, a signal of an autoload written `<Autoload>.<signal>` (`LifesimEvents.crop_harvested`; see `GameEvent`). |
| `condition` | `String` | `""` | What must hold when the event fires, in the `GameQuery` syntax; empty means always. `EVENT_ARG` and `EVENT_ARG_AT_LEAST` read the event's arguments by name (`EVENT_ARG crop_id turnip`, `EVENT_ARG_AT_LEAST quantity 3`), and here and in `actions` an argument written `$name` is the event's argument (`ADD_MONEY $price`). |
| `actions` | `PackedStringArray` | `PackedStringArray()` | What the trigger does, in order (`GameRules.run_actions()`); an action that fails stops the ones after it. |
| `repeat_per` | `StringName` |  | An integer argument of the event to run the actions once per unit of (`quantity`: once per crop harvested); empty runs them once. |
| `once` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the trigger fires only once in a world: once all its actions ran. An action that failed (a full inventory) after others ran leaves it pending: the next time the event fires, it resumes at that action with the arguments of the event that set it off and without checking the condition again, so the ones before it are not given twice. One whose first action failed gave nothing and fires anew. It cannot repeat per an argument, which would make how much it gives depend on the retry, and its event declares only what a save keeps: booleans, numbers, text and positions. |

## vital

`VitalData` (core). Something of the player's the game counts down and refills (`Vitals`): health, energy, mana, hunger. Work and attacks spend it, food and sleep restore it, enemies drain it; the module that owns a use names the vital in its settings (`CombatSettings.health_vital_id`).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  |  |
| `maximum` | `int`, 1 to 9999 | `100` | How much a full one holds at the start of a game. |
| `refill_on_sleep` | `bool` | `true` | Whether a night's sleep fills it again (`SleepSpot`). |
| `maximum_stat` | `StringName` |  | A stat its maximum follows (`GameStats`, registered by a module or the game: combat's `max_health`): the stat's bonuses add to the maximum and its multipliers scale it, so a boon or a lasting upgrade raises it. None follows none. |

## weather

`WeatherData` (core). A kind of weather (clear skies, rain, a storm, snow): what it is called, whether it waters what grows outside, and how the `WeatherOverlay` shows it. A game lists its weather as content and rolls it per season (`GameDefinition.weather_odds`); a game without any has no weather.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  |  |
| `wets_ground` | `bool` | `false` | Whether it waters the ground outside: what grows there needs no watering. |
| `particle` | `Particle` | `Particle.NONE` | What falls from the sky, drawn by the `WeatherOverlay`. Values: NONE = 0, RAIN = 1, SNOW = 2. |
| `density` | `float`, 0 to 3 | `1.0` | How much falls: 1 is a shower. |
| `fall_speed` | `float`, 0.05 to 3 | `1.0` | How fast it falls: 1 is rain's pace. |
| `wind` | `float`, -20 to 20 | `4.0` | How far the wind blows it aside: pixels per rain streak. |
| `particle_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.72, 0.84, 1.0, 0.36)` | The colour of what falls. |
| `tint` | `Color` | `Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)` | The colour laid over the view (alpha 0: none). |
| `lightning` | `bool` | `false` | Whether lightning flashes now and then. |

## elite

`EliteData` (combat). A stronger form any creature can take (`HostileCreature.elite`): a Hulking Slime is a slime with more health, a harder hit and a larger body, tinted, worth more experience and leaving more of its drop. A place that spawns creatures rolls for one (`roll()`), a dungeon more often the deeper it goes; `CombatEvents.elite_defeated` tells of each that falls.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` | Its creature's name in it, `%s` the kind's name: "Hulking %s". |
| `condition` | `String` | `""` | What must hold for a place to roll it (`GameRules` syntax; empty: always). |
| `health_scale` | `float`, 0.1 to 10 | `1.5` | How much of its kind's health, contact damage and move speed it has. |
| `damage_scale` | `float`, 0.1 to 10 | `1.0` |  |
| `speed_scale` | `float`, 0.1 to 10 | `1.0` |  |
| `size_scale` | `float`, 0.5 to 3 | `1.0` | How much larger it is drawn, and how much it is hit where it stands. |
| `tint` | `Color` | `Color.WHITE` | Its colour over its kind's (`EnemyData.sprite_tint`). |
| `affliction_id` | `StringName` |  | What its hits lay on the player in place of its kind's (`EnemyData.affliction_id`): a searing form's burn; empty, its kind's. |
| `xp_scale` | `float`, 0 to 10 | `1.5` | How much of its kind's experience it is worth. |
| `extra_drops` | `int`, 0 to 99 | `1` | How many more of its kind's drop it leaves. |

## enemy

`EnemyData` (combat). A kind of creature that fights the player in real time (`HostileCreature`, which a scene places with its id): how it looks and moves, how hard it hits and how it is hurt, what it lays on the player, the side it is on, and what it drops and is worth once defeated. An `EliteData` form makes one stronger.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `"Enemy"` | The name the player reads (the bestiary, where an item comes from). |
| `sprite_path` | `String` |  | Its sprite sheet, cells of `frame_size` in rows (`SheetAnimator`); empty or missing, it is drawn as a shape of its `fallback_color`. |
| `sprite_tint` | `Color` | `Color.WHITE` | Multiplies the colours of the `sprite_path` art: one sheet in another palette serves another enemy (a cave slime from a green slime's sheet). |
| `fallback_color` | `Color` | `Color(0.35, 0.75, 0.38)` | The colour of the shape an enemy is drawn as while it has no `sprite_path` art. |
| `frame_size` | `Vector2i` | `Vector2i(32, 32)` | The size of a cell of its sheet, in pixels. |
| `animation_fps` | `int`, 1 to 60 | `12` | How fast its frames play. |
| `idle_from` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `0` | The first and last frames, counted from 0 along the rows of its sheet, it plays standing, moving and once when defeated (that long it lies there). |
| `idle_to` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `0` |  |
| `move_from` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `0` |  |
| `move_to` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `0` |  |
| `death_from` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `0` |  |
| `death_to` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `0` |  |
| `max_health` | `int`, 1 to 999 | `30` | Its health, before the player's foe strength scales it. |
| `move_speed` | `float`, 1 to 300 | `36.0` | How fast it moves, in pixels a second. |
| `chase_radius` | `float`, 8 to 400 | `110.0` | How near the player must come for it to chase them; farther, it gives up. |
| `attack_range` | `float`, 4 to 320 | `16.0` | How near the player must be for it to strike, or to shoot (`shot_speed`). |
| `contact_damage` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `8` | The damage of each strike or shot. |
| `attack_cooldown` | `float`, 0.1 to 10 s | `1.2` | How long it waits after a strike or a shot before the next. |
| `windup_seconds` | `float`, 0 to 2 | `0.0` | How long it winds up a strike once the player is in reach, standing still and glowing (`HostileCreature.windup_color`), so the player sees it coming: a step out of reach or a hit that stuns it before it lands spares them. 0 strikes at once (a slime that hurts at a touch). |
| `shot_speed` | `float`, 0 to 600 | `0.0` | With a speed, it strikes from afar: it throws a shot (`Projectile`) that flies this fast, in pixels a second, at where the player stands, for its `contact_damage`, and fades past half again its `attack_range`; a wall stops it and a step aside dodges it. It backs away from a player who comes near (`HostileCreature.SHOT_KEEP_AWAY`). 0 strikes in reach. |
| `shot_color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.25)` | The colour its shots glow in. |
| `affliction_id` | `StringName` |  | What its strikes and shots lay on the player they hurt besides (`AfflictionData`): an ember wisp's embers burn; empty, nothing. |
| `immune_to` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | The afflictions that never take hold of it (`Hurtbox.immune_to`): an ember wisp does not burn. |
| `faction_id` | `StringName` | `FactionData.MONSTERS` | The side it fights on (`FactionData`): it hurts and is hurt by the others. |
| `knockback` | `float`, 0 to 600 | `90.0` | How hard its strike pushes the player, in pixels a second. |
| `knockback_scale` | `float`, 0 to 4 | `1.0` | How far a hit pushes it: 0 for not at all, 1 for the hit's full push. |
| `collision_size` | `Vector2` | `Vector2(16, 12)` | The box it stands in and is hit in, in pixels. |
| `visual_offset` | `Vector2` | `Vector2(0, -5)` | Where its sprite is drawn from where it stands, in pixels. |
| `visual_scale` | `float`, 0.1 to 4 | `1.0` | How large its sprite is drawn. |
| `drop_item_id` | `StringName` |  | The item (`ItemData`) it drops when defeated; empty, none. |
| `drop_quantity` | `int`, 0 to 99 | `1` | How many of it it drops, before the player's loot stat and an elite's extra. |
| `respawn_days` | `int`, 1 to 28 | `1` | How many days after its defeat it comes back. |
| `combat_xp` | `int`, 0 to 9999 | `20` | Combat experience a defeat is worth, which `CombatEvents.enemy_defeated` passes on for the game to award (0: none). |

## affliction

`AfflictionData` (damage). Something a hit lays on what it hurts besides (`Damage.affliction_id`), a burn, a poison or a sticky slime: for `seconds` it takes `tick_damage` of health every `tick_seconds`, with neither a push nor a stun, and shows in its `color` as it does, and it may slow what it is on (`speed_scale`). A hit that lays it again has it last as long again rather than adding another. Any kind of fight may lay it: what lays it and what keeps it is the fight's own, in real time the hits of creatures, hazards and the player's weapons that carry its `weapon_tag`, or any of the player's hits by the chance its `chance_stat` gives.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `color` | `Color` | `Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.18)` |  |
| `seconds` | `float`, 0.1 to 60 s | `3.0` | How long it lasts from the hit that laid it. |
| `tick_seconds` | `float`, 0.1 to 10 s | `1.0` | How often it takes health. |
| `tick_damage` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `1` | The health each tick takes; 0, none: one that only slows. |
| `speed_scale` | `float`, 0.1 to 1 | `1.0` | How fast what it is on goes while it lasts, as a share of its speed: its steps in real time and in a command battle, its time gauge in a grid battle. 1: as fast as ever; of two that slow, the slower counts. |
| `weapon_tag` | `String` | `""` | The tag of the player's weapons whose hits lay it (an ember blade's burn); empty, none. |
| `chance_stat` | `StringName` |  | The stat (`GameStats`, which the game registers) that is the chance, in percent, that a hit of the player's lays it whatever their weapon (Ember Depths' Kindling boon, a blow in four burning); empty, none. |

## faction

`FactionData` (damage). A side in a fight. Any two different factions are enemies, unless one lists the other among its `allies`; a faction never hurts itself, and damage of no faction (a trap, a fall) hurts every side. A faction needs an entry only to have allies (a pet on the player's side): an id alone names a side.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allies` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | The factions this one never hurts and is never hurt by. |

## food_buff

`FoodBuffData` (items). What eating a food or drinking a potion does to the player's stats for a while besides what it restores (`ItemData.food_buff_id`): it changes stats of `GameStats` by `multipliers` and `bonuses` for `duration_minutes` of the game's clock (`BuffService`). Several may hold at once, and one eaten again while it holds starts its time again rather than adding to it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  | The name the player reads while it holds. |
| `description` | `String`, several lines |  | What the player reads of it. |
| `duration_minutes` | `int`, 1 to 1440 | `180` | How long it holds, in minutes of the game's clock. |
| `multipliers` | `Dictionary[StringName, float]` | `{}` | Multiplier of each stat the buff changes, as stat -> factor: stats an installed module or the game reads (`GameStats.register_stat()`). |
| `bonuses` | `Dictionary[StringName, float]` | `{}` | Amount added to each stat the buff changes, as stat -> amount. |

## item

`ItemData` (items). Something the player can carry in the inventory (`InventoryState`), buy and sell (`ShopData`, `sell_price`), eat or drink (`restores`, `food_buff_id`), use as a tool or a weapon (`tool_action`, `tool_power`), sow (`crop_id`) or build (`placeable_id`), as its `kind` says. Content asks about it by id and by its `tags` (the condition `ITEM_TAG`).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  | The name the player reads. |
| `description` | `String`, several lines |  | What the player reads of it in the inventory and the shops. |
| `max_stack` | `int`, 1 to 999 | `99` | How many one inventory slot holds; a tool's is 1. |
| `icon` | `Texture2D` |  |  |
| `kind` | `Kind` | `Kind.MATERIAL` | Values: MATERIAL = 0, FOOD = 1, SEED = 2 (Sown to grow its `crop_id`), TOOL = 3 (Used for its `tool_action`; a tool never stacks and cannot be shipped), CROP = 4, GIFT = 5, QUEST = 6 (Kept for a quest; it cannot be shipped), PLACEABLE = 7 (Built as its `placeable_id`), POTION = 8 (Drunk rather than eaten: a potion restores and buffs as food does). |
| `buy_price` | `int`, 0 to 999999 | `0` | What a shop asks for it where the shop's stock leaves the price to the item (a price of 0, `ShopData.stock`). |
| `sell_price` | `int`, 0 to 999999 | `0` | What a shop pays for it; 0, it cannot be sold. |
| `restores` | `Dictionary[StringName, int]` | `{}` | What eating or drinking it restores, as vital id (`VitalData`) → amount. |
| `food_buff_id` | `StringName` |  | The food buff (`FoodBuffData`) eating or drinking it gives; empty, none. |
| `tags` | `PackedStringArray` | `PackedStringArray()` | Words content asks about it by (`ITEM_TAG <item> <tag>`): a quest that counts every fish caught, the player's weapons whose hits lay an affliction (`AfflictionData.weapon_tag`), the items a new game carries over (`ItemInheritance.tags`). |
| `tool_action` | `StringName` |  | What the tool does: an action some installed module or the game responds to. Whoever handles an action names it with a constant of its own (the module that tills soil names "till") and registers it (`register_tool_action()`); content checks reject a tool whose action nobody registered. |
| `tool_power` | `int`, 1 to 999 | `1` | How strong the tool is: the damage a weapon deals before the player's stats (`WeaponUse`), the rocks a pick breaks and how fast (`MiningNodeData.required_tool_power`), the energy a hoe or a watering can spends on a plot (divided by it); a better tool raises it (`ToolUpgradeData`). |
| `crop_id` | `StringName` |  | The crop (`CropData`) a seed grows. |
| `placeable_id` | `StringName` |  | The placeable (`PlaceableData`) a placeable item builds. |

## placeable

`PlaceableData` (items). A structure the player builds in the world from its item and packs up again (`BuildingPlacementService`): a chest, a furnace, a sprinkler. Its scene is what stands there, and it may do something each day around it (`daily_effect`).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  | The name the player reads. |
| `item_id` | `StringName` |  | The item (`ItemData`, a `PLACEABLE` that names this placeable) that builds it and that packing it up gives back. |
| `scene_path` | `String`, a *.tscn file |  | What stands where it is built: a scene whose root is a `PlacedStructure`. |
| `snap_size` | `int`, 8 to 128 | `16` | The grid, in pixels, a spot to build it snaps to. |
| `minimum_spacing` | `float`, 0 to 256 | `20.0` | How near another structure it may stand, in pixels; of two, the larger counts. |
| `daily_effect` | `StringName` |  | What it does each day within its `effect_radius`, an effect some module asks about (`BuildingPlacementService.is_point_affected()`): "water", a sprinkler that waters the farm plots around it; empty, none. |
| `effect_radius` | `float`, 0 to 512 | `0.0` | How far its `daily_effect` reaches, in pixels. |
| `allowed_location_types` | `Array[WorldLocationData.LocationType]` | `[]` | The kinds of location it may be built in; empty, any. Values: TOWN = 0, INTERIOR = 1, WILDERNESS = 2, DUNGEON = 3. |
| `allowed_location_ids` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | The locations (`WorldLocationData`) it may be built in; empty, any of the allowed kinds. |

## recipe

`RecipeData` (items). What the player makes from what they carry: `ingredients` swapped for the `output_item_id` in one step (`CraftingService`), at a station of its `category` (`CraftingStation`), once its `condition` holds.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  | The name the player reads. |
| `category` | `Category` | `Category.CRAFTING` | Values: CRAFTING = 0, COOKING = 1. |
| `ingredients` | `Dictionary` | `{}` | What it takes, as item id -> count. |
| `output_item_id` | `StringName` |  | The item (`ItemData`) it makes. |
| `output_quantity` | `int`, 1 to 99 | `1` | How many of it one craft makes. |
| `condition` | `String` | `""` | When the recipe can be crafted, as a `GameRules` query; empty: always. |

## shop

`ShopData` (items). A shop: the items it sells and at what price, those it sells only in a season, and its other offers (`ShopOffer`, an animal). A `ShopStand` in a scene opens its counter (`ShopMenu`); it buys every item that has a `sell_price`, and `ShopService` makes each trade.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `"Shop"` | The name the player reads at its counter. |
| `stock` | `Dictionary` | `{}` | What it sells all year, as item id -> price; 0, at the item's own `buy_price`, so a price every shop asks is set once, on the item. |
| `seasonal_stock` | `Dictionary` | `{}` | What it sells besides in a season, as season name (`GameCalendar`) -> item id -> price (0, the item's own); a seasonal price takes the place of the year's. |
| `offers` | `Array[ShopOffer]` | `[]` | What the shop sells besides items, after them (see `ShopOffer`). |

## stat_upgrade

`StatUpgradeData` (items). A lasting upgrade the player buys level by level, at a stand (`StatUpgradeStand`): each level changes stats (`multipliers` and `bonuses`, of stats an installed module or the game reads, once more for each level) for as long as the world lasts, across days and runs, and costs money (`money_costs`) and items (`materials`). Its level lives in the world (`stat_upgrade:<id>`), so it saves with it. Content asks about one with `STAT_UPGRADE_AT_LEAST <upgrade> <level>` and gives a level with `RAISE_STAT_UPGRADE <upgrade>`; `ItemsEvents.stat_upgraded` tells of each level. The world's upgrades are a `GameStats` source (`StatUpgrades`).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `description` | `String`, several lines | `""` |  |
| `condition` | `String` | `""` | When the player may buy its next level: a `GameRules` query; empty, always. |
| `max_level` | `int`, 1 to 99 | `1` | How many levels it has. |
| `money_costs` | `PackedInt32Array` | `PackedInt32Array()` | The money each level costs, from the first; a level past the end of the list costs as much as the last. |
| `materials` | `Dictionary[StringName, int]` | `{}` | The items each level costs, as item id -> how many. |
| `multipliers` | `Dictionary[StringName, float]` | `{}` | Multiplier of each stat it changes, as stat -> factor, per level. |
| `bonuses` | `Dictionary[StringName, float]` | `{}` | Amount added to each stat it changes, as stat -> amount, per level. |

## calendar_event

`CalendarEventData` (lifesim). A happening of the calendar, a fair or a market: on in its `seasons`, on its `day_of_season` and `days_of_week`, from `start_minute` to `end_minute`, at its location (`CalendarEventManager`). While it is on, the player may claim its participation reward once a year at a `CalendarEventBooth`, and content asks whether it is on with `EVENT_ACTIVE <event>`.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  | The name the player reads. |
| `location_id` | `StringName` |  | The location (`WorldLocationData`) it is held in, whose booths may give its reward; empty, anywhere. |
| `seasons` | `PackedStringArray` | `PackedStringArray()` | The seasons of the game's calendar it is on in; empty, every season. |
| `day_of_season` | `int`, 0 to 28 or more | `0` | The day of the season it is on, from 1; 0, every day. |
| `days_of_week` | `PackedInt32Array` | `PackedInt32Array()` | The days of the week it is on, from 0 for the first; empty, every day. |
| `start_minute` | , 0 to 1439 | `9 * 60` | When it begins and ends, in minutes after midnight; it is over at `end_minute`. |
| `end_minute` | , 1 to 1440 | `17 * 60` |  |
| `reward_money` | `int`, 0 to 999999 | `0` | What taking part gives once a year: money, items (item id -> count) and experience of a skill (`SkillData`). |
| `reward_items` | `Dictionary` | `{}` |  |
| `reward_skill` | `StringName` |  |  |
| `reward_skill_xp` | `int`, 0 to 9999 | `0` |  |

## collection_milestone

`CollectionMilestoneData` (lifesim). A reward of the player's collection log (`CollectionService`): for having discovered a number of the items of a `category` (harvested, caught, mined, ...), or for having claimed every one of its `prerequisites`. The player claims its reward once it is ready (`CollectionMilestoneService`).

`CropData` (lifesim). What a seed grows into on a farm plot (`FarmPlot`, `ItemData.crop_id`): it matures in `days_to_mature` watered days in its seasons, gives its harvest item, and with `regrow_days` grows again after a harvest.

| `speaking_style` | `String`, several lines |  |  |
| `home_location_id` | `StringName` |  | Where they live and where they are found most (`WorldLocationData`), for their context and the game's menus; where they stand comes from their `schedule_entries`. |
| `default_location_id` | `StringName` |  |  |
| `ai_enabled` | `bool` | `false` | Whether the NPC chats about the topics the player brings up instead of saying its daily lines, in a game with a module that makes chats (npc_ai); its heart events play all the same. |
| `context_world_keys` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | The `WorldState` keys whose values their chat context carries, facts of the world they know about. |
| `birthday_season` | `String` | `""` | A season of the game's calendar; none ("") for an NPC without a birthday. |
| `birthday_day` | `int`, 1 to 28 or more | `1` | The day of `birthday_season` it falls on, from 1. |
| `dialogue_titles_by_hearts` | `Dictionary` | `{}` | The dialogue they say from a number of hearts on, as hearts -> title in their dialogue: the highest the player has reached takes the place of the daily one. |
| `visual_strip_root` | `String`, a folder |  | The folder of their sprite strips (`DirectionalActorVisual`), and the colour their sprite is tinted. |
| `visual_modulate` | `Color` | `Color.WHITE` |  |
| `schedule_entries` | `Array[NpcScheduleEntry]` | `[]` | Where they stand at each time of the day, the season and the weather (`NpcScheduleEntry`). |
| `loved_items` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | The items (`ItemData`) they love, like and dislike as gifts, and the item tags they love and like; a gift they have no feeling for still pleases them a little (`friendship_for_gift()`). |
| `liked_items` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` |  |
| `disliked_items` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` |  |
| `loved_tags` | `PackedStringArray` | `PackedStringArray()` |  |
| `liked_tags` | `PackedStringArray` | `PackedStringArray()` |  |

## mail

`MailData` (progression). A letter that arrives in the player's mailbox once its condition holds (`MailService`), from an NPC or a name of its own, with a reward of items and money the player claims from it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sender_npc_id` | `StringName` |  | Who it is from: an NPC (`NpcProfileData`), or a name of its own, which takes the NPC's place. |
| `sender_name` | `String` |  |  |
| `subject` | `String` |  | Its subject line and its text, as the player reads them. |
| `body` | `String`, several lines |  |  |
| `condition` | `String` | `""` | When the letter arrives, in the `GameQuery` syntax (`DAY_AT_LEAST 2`, `QUEST_COMPLETED first_harvest, HEARTS mira 2`); empty means at once. The mail service checks it each day and whenever a quest, a friendship or the world's state changes. |
| `reward_items` | `Dictionary` | `{}` | What it brings for the player to claim: items (item id -> count) and money. |
| `reward_money` | `int`, 0 to 999999 | `0` |  |

## quest

`QuestData` (progression). A quest: what it asks of the player (`objectives`, each counted from an event of any module), what it gives when every objective is met, and the quest it leads to. `QuestState` runs them.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` |  | The name the player reads in the quest log. |
| `description` | `String`, several lines |  | What the player reads of it. |
| `entry_point` | `bool` | `false` | Whether it begins a chain: every quest must be one or be led to from one (`next_quest_id`). |
| `auto_start` | `bool` | `false` | Whether a new game starts it at once; otherwise content starts it (a trigger's `START_QUEST`, an earlier quest of its chain). |
| `objectives` | `Array[QuestObjective]` | `[]` | What the quest asks, all of which must be met; at least one. |
| `reward_money` | `int`, 0 to 999999 | `0` | What completing it gives: money and items (item id -> count). |
| `reward_items` | `Dictionary` | `{}` |  |
| `next_quest_id` | `StringName` |  | The quest (`QuestData`) completing it starts; empty, the chain ends. |

## tool_upgrade

`ToolUpgradeData` (progression). A better tool for a tool the player has (`ToolUpgradeService`): the source tool, materials and money go, the result tool comes, in the old one's hotbar slots, once its condition holds. The result must be stronger (`ItemData.tool_power`).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  | The name the player reads. |
| `source_item_id` | `StringName` |  | The tool (`ItemData`, a `TOOL`) it takes, and the stronger one it gives. |
| `result_item_id` | `StringName` |  |  |
| `materials` | `Dictionary` | `{}` | What it costs besides the tool: materials (item id -> count) and money. |
| `money_cost` | `int`, 0 to 999999 | `0` |  |
| `condition` | `String` | `""` | When the upgrade is offered, as a `GameRules` query; empty: always. |

## town_project

`TownProjectData` (progression). A community project of the town (`TownProjectService`): the player donates the items it asks (`requirements`) until all are in, and then claims its reward. It opens once its prerequisites are complete, and content asks about it with `PROJECT_COMPLETED <project>`.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `"Town Project"` | The name the player reads. |
| `description` | `String`, several lines |  | What the player reads of it. |
| `location_id` | `StringName` |  | The location (`WorldLocationData`) whose project board lists it. |
| `prerequisites` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | The projects (`TownProjectData`) that must be complete before it opens. |
| `requirements` | `Dictionary` | `{}` | What it asks the player to donate, as item id -> count. |
| `reward_money` | `int`, 0 to 999999 | `0` | What claiming it once complete gives: money and items (item id -> count). |
| `reward_items` | `Dictionary` | `{}` |  |

## boon

`BoonData` (roguelite). A boon a run may take: a change to the player that lasts the run. The player picks it from a few the run offers (`RunService.offer_boons()`, a `BoonAltar`), or content gives it (`TAKE_BOON <boon>`). While the run goes on it changes stats (`multipliers` and `bonuses`, of stats an installed module or the game reads, `GameStats.register_stat()`), once more for each time the run took it, and it acts once each time it is taken (`actions`: a heal, coins). Each boon belongs to a pool (`pool`): an altar offers one pool's, so a game keeps apart the boons of different altars, or the pacts a run may start under (a burden with a reward, taken as it starts).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `description` | `String`, several lines | `""` |  |
| `condition` | `String` | `""` | When a run may take it: a `GameRules` query; empty, always. |
| `pool` | `StringName` |  | The pool it is offered from (`RunService.offer_boons()`, `BoonAltar.pool`); empty, the common one. |
| `weight` | `int`, 1 to 100 | `10` | How often it is offered against the others: twice the weight, twice as often. |
| `max_stacks` | `int`, 1 to 99 | `1` | How many times one run may take it; `UNLIMITED`, as often as offered. |
| `multipliers` | `Dictionary[StringName, float]` | `{}` | Multiplier of each stat the boon changes, as stat -> factor, per time taken. |
| `bonuses` | `Dictionary[StringName, float]` | `{}` | Amount added to each stat the boon changes, as stat -> amount, per time taken. |
| `actions` | `PackedStringArray` | `PackedStringArray()` | `GameRules` actions run each time it is taken. |

## run_tally

`RunTallyData` (roguelite). A number one run keeps: the creatures it defeated, the depth it reached. Content counts it with `ADD_RUN_TALLY <tally> [amount]`, usually from a trigger (`TriggerData`) on what the player does, or the game's code with `RunService.add_tally()` and `raise_tally()`; `RUN_TALLY_AT_LEAST` asks about it. The run's report (`RunService.get_last_report()`) lists every tally the run raised, and a tally with a `best_flag` keeps the best of any run in the player's profile, which a record (`RecordData`) or an achievement's progress (`AchievementData.progress_flag`) shows.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `order` | `int` | `0` | Where it stands in a run's report: lower first, then by id. |
| `best_flag` | `StringName` |  | The profile counter (`GameProfile`) that keeps the best this tally reached in any run, raised as the run raises the tally; none keeps no best. |

## rts_map

`RtsMapData` (rts). A command battle a game sets up: the size of its field in pixels, the rectangles no unit walks through (rocks, walls, water), the ground a side wins by holding (`goal_area`), how long it lasts at most (`time_limit`), the side the player commands, the units each side starts with, and whether the units the player does not command march on their foes or wait for them. The rts module's minigame plays it (`RtsBattleGame`, setting `map`).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `size` | `Vector2` | `Vector2(480.0, 216.0)` |  |
| `obstacles` | `Array[Rect2]` | `[]` |  |
| `player_faction_id` | `StringName` | `FactionData.PLAYER` | The side the player commands (`FactionData`); its allies fight with it. |
| `placements` | `Array[RtsPlacement]` | `[]` |  |
| `computer_advances` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the units the player does not command march on the nearest foe when they have nothing to do; if not, they wait where they stand until a foe comes in sight, and then go after it as any unit with nothing to do. |
| `goal_area` | `Rect2` | `Rect2()` | The ground a side wins the battle by holding (a camp's fire, a hilltop): once units of the side of `goal_faction_id` stood in it with no foe among them, healers aside, for `goal_seconds` in all, that side wins (`RtsGoal`), the player's when it is theirs; and the units the player does not command that advance march on it rather than on their nearest foe. With no area, the battle ends only when one side is left. |
| `goal_seconds` | `float`, 1 to 600 s | `30.0` | The seconds of holding the ground that win the battle. |
| `goal_faction_id` | `StringName` |  | The side that wins by holding the ground (`FactionData`); empty, the player's. |
| `time_limit` | `float`, 0 to 900 s | `0.0` | The most seconds of battle time the battle lasts: once they pass, the side of `time_faction_id` wins (`BattleTimeLimit`), the player's when it is theirs (a stand to hold out) and the foes' when it is not (a raid to win in time); 0, no limit. |
| `time_faction_id` | `StringName` |  | The side that wins once time runs out (`FactionData`); empty, the player's. |

## rts_unit

`RtsUnitData` (rts). A kind of unit that fights in command battles (`RtsMapData.placements`): a footman, a bowman, a raider. It walks the field at `move_speed`, attacks a foe at most `attack_range` away from its edge once every `attack_cooldown` seconds, and goes after foes it sees (`sight_range`) when it has no order that keeps it from them (`RtsBattle`). A healer (`heal`) mends its side instead of fighting. A unit may be strong against some kinds (`strong_against`): it hits them harder and goes after them first. Its attacks may lay an affliction (`affliction_id`), some afflictions never take hold of it (`immune_to`), and a healer may lift them (`cures`). Distances are in pixels of the field.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `texture` | `Texture2D` |  | What the field shows of it; none: a disc of `color` with its name's initial. |
| `color` | `Color` | `Color(0.55, 0.6, 0.7)` |  |
| `max_health` | `int`, 1 to 9999 | `30` |  |
| `damage` | `int`, 1 to 999 | `5` | The health an attack takes, less the target's `armor`, never below 1. |
| `armor` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `0` |  |
| `attack_range` | `float`, 1 to 400 | `4.0` | How far from its edge to a foe's edge it attacks: a few pixels for a blade, many for a bow. |
| `heal` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `0` | The health it mends instead of attacking: a healer goes after the most hurt unit it sees of a side it does not fight, itself aside, and mends it from `attack_range` once every `attack_cooldown`, and never strikes a foe. 0: it fights. |
| `cures` | `bool` | `false` | Whether its mending also lifts every affliction on the friend it mends (`RtsUnit.afflictions`): a field medic who puts out a burn. Only a healer cures. |
| `attack_cooldown` | `float`, 0.1 to 10 | `1.0` | The seconds between its attacks. |
| `move_speed` | `float`, 1 to 400 | `30.0` | How fast it walks, in pixels a second. |
| `sight_range` | `float`, 1 to 600 | `80.0` | How far from its edge it notices a foe and goes after it. |
| `radius` | `float`, 2 to 32 | `5.0` | The size of its round body, which other units keep out of. |
| `strong_against` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | The kinds of unit (`RtsUnitData` ids) its attacks hit `strong_multiplier` times as hard, and which it goes after before the rest it sees: a rider running down slingers, a spear holding off a brute. |
| `strong_multiplier` | `float`, 1 to 4 | `2.0` |  |
| `affliction_id` | `StringName` |  | The affliction (`AfflictionData`) its attacks lay on the foes they leave standing, a burn that takes more health in battle time; empty, none. |
| `immune_to` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | The afflictions (`AfflictionData` ids) that never take hold of it: a fire-born brute that never burns. |

## skill

`SkillData` (skills). A skill the player levels up with experience (`Skills.add_xp()`), which the game grants for what the player does. Its perks change stats from the levels they name on.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` |  |  |
| `short_name` | `String` |  | The name where space is short (the HUD line); empty uses `display_name`. |
| `order` | `int` | `0` | Where the skill is listed among the game's skills: lower first, then by id. |
| `level_xp` | `PackedInt32Array` | `PackedInt32Array()` | Experience to reach level 2, 3, ...: one rising amount per level above 1. |
| `perks` | `Array[SkillPerk]` | `[]` | What the skill grants, by the level that unlocks it. |

## battle_action

`BattleActionData` (tactics). What a unit can do on its turn in a grid battle (`BattleUnitData.action_ids`): a strike, a shot, a spell that hits an area, a heal. It aims at a cell from `min_range` to `max_range` steps from the unit (`BattleGrid.distance()`) and reaches the units within `area` steps of that cell that it affects: those hostile to the user's side when it does damage, those of the user's side, the user too, when it heals. It never hurts its own side. A strong one may need to recharge (`recharge_turns`): its user then waits turns before it takes it again. One that does damage may also set back the time gauges of the foes it leaves standing (`delay`), so their turns come later. Any may boost the attack or defense of the units it reaches and leaves standing (`boosts`) for some of their turns: a blessing on its own side, a curse on its foes. One that does damage may lay an affliction on the foes it leaves standing (`affliction_id`), a poison that takes their health on its ticks in battle time, and one that heals may lift the afflictions on the units it reaches (`cures`).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `effect` | `Effect` | `Effect.DAMAGE` | Values: DAMAGE = 0 (Takes health: its power and the user's attack, less the target's defense (each with its boosts, `GridUnit.get_attack()`), at least 1), HEAL = 1 (Gives back health: its power). |
| `power` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `4` |  |
| `min_range` | `int`, 0 to 12 | `1` | How near and how far the cell it aims at may be, in steps; 0 is the user's own cell. |
| `max_range` | `int`, 0 to 12 | `1` |  |
| `area` | `int`, 0 to 4 | `0` | How many steps from the aimed cell it reaches too; 0: that cell alone. |
| `recharge_turns` | `int`, 0 to 9 | `0` | How many of its user's turns go by after it takes it before it may take it again; 0: on every turn. |
| `delay` | `float`, 0 to 100 | `0.0` | How far it sets back the time gauge of each foe it hits and leaves standing (`AtbBattle.GAUGE_FULL` is a whole turn), no further than empty; 0: not at all. Only an action that does damage delays. |
| `boosts` | `Dictionary[StringName, int]` | `{}` | How it changes the attack and defense (`GridUnit.ATTACK`, `GridUnit.DEFENSE`) of each unit it reaches and leaves standing, as stat -> amount, through that unit's next `boost_turns` turns (`GridUnit.boost()`): more on its own side when it heals, less on its foes when it does damage; empty, none. |
| `boost_turns` | `int`, 1 to 9 | `2` |  |
| `affliction_id` | `StringName` |  | What it lays on each foe it hits and leaves standing (`AfflictionData`, `GridUnit.afflict()`): a poisoned dart; empty, nothing. Only an action that does damage lays one. |
| `cures` | `bool` | `false` | Whether it lifts every affliction on each unit it heals (`GridUnit.afflictions`): a cleansing prayer. Only an action that heals cures. |

## battle_map

`BattleMapData` (tactics). A grid battle a game sets up: the size of its grid, the cells no unit stands on or walks through (water, walls), the cells that give cover (woods, ruins: a unit there takes `cover_reduction` less damage), the rough ground (shallows, mud: entering it takes `rough_cost` steps), the cells a side wins by taking (a beacon, a banner: `goal_cells`), how long it lasts at most (`time_limit`), the side the player commands and the units each side starts with. The tactics module's minigame plays it (`GridBattleGame`, setting `map`).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `size` | `Vector2i` | `Vector2i(8, 6)` |  |
| `blocked_cells` | `Array[Vector2i]` | `[]` |  |
| `cover_cells` | `Array[Vector2i]` | `[]` | The open cells that give cover to who stands there. |
| `cover_reduction` | `float`, 0 to 0.9 | `0.3` | The share of damage a unit in cover does not take. |
| `rough_cells` | `Array[Vector2i]` | `[]` | The open cells that take more steps to enter. |
| `rough_cost` | `int`, 2 to 4 | `2` | The steps entering rough ground takes. |
| `goal_cells` | `Array[Vector2i]` | `[]` | The open cells a side wins the battle by taking: a unit of the side of `goal_faction_id` that ends its turn on one wins it for that side, the player's when it is theirs (a banner to seize) and the foes' when it is not (a beacon to keep unlit); empty, the battle ends only when one side is left. |
| `goal_faction_id` | `StringName` |  | The side that takes the goal cells (`FactionData`); empty, the player's. |
| `player_faction_id` | `StringName` | `FactionData.PLAYER` | The side the player commands (`FactionData`); its allies fight with it. |
| `placements` | `Array[BattlePlacement]` | `[]` |  |
| `time_limit` | `float`, 0 to 900 s | `0.0` | The most seconds of battle time the battle lasts: once they pass, the side of `time_faction_id` wins (`BattleTimeLimit`), the player's when it is theirs (a stand to hold out) and the foes' when it is not (a raid to win in time); 0, no limit. |
| `time_faction_id` | `StringName` |  | The side that wins once time runs out (`FactionData`); empty, the player's. |

## battle_unit

`BattleUnitData` (tactics). A kind of unit that fights in grid battles (`BattleMapData.placements`): a soldier, an archer, a raider. Its gauge fills at `speed` (`AtbBattle`), and on its turn it walks up to `move` cells and takes one of its actions.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display_name` | `String` | `""` |  |
| `texture` | `Texture2D` |  | What a cell shows of it; none: a disc of `color` with its name's initial. |
| `color` | `Color` | `Color(0.55, 0.6, 0.7)` |  |
| `max_health` | `int`, 1 to 9999 | `20` |  |
| `attack` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `4` | What it adds to the damage it does (`BattleActionData.amount_for()`). |
| `defense` | `int`, 0 to 999 | `1` | What it takes off the damage it is done. |
| `speed` | `float`, 1 to 100 | `20.0` | How fast its gauge fills, in points a second: a turn comes every `AtbBattle.GAUGE_FULL / speed` seconds. |
| `move` | `int`, 0 to 12 | `3` | How many cells it walks on a turn. |
| `action_ids` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | What it can do on its turn (`BattleActionData`), its plain attack first. |
| `immune_to` | `Array[StringName]` | `[]` | The afflictions that never take hold of it (`AfflictionData`): a warlord who shrugs off poison. |
